title: Cotton acreage estimates trimmed
summary: Planted area estimates trimmed for the new season; stocks-to-use ratio edging lower.

title: Paraxylene margins firm
summary: Feedstock margins firm as Asian crackers run at reduced rates; polyester chip offers edging up.

title: Caprolactam plant maintenance
summary: Scheduled maintenance at a major caprolactam plant tightens nylon 6 chip availability for several weeks.

title: Hide supply steady
summary: Slaughter volumes steady in Europe; raw hide prices flat, tanners hold finished leather offers.

title: Nickel surcharge unchanged
summary: Mills left the nickel alloy surcharge unchanged for the month; 304 coil lead times stable at 6-8 weeks.

title: Forward power curve steepens
summary: Winter baseload contracts trade above the summer strip as gas storage refills slowly.

title: Containerboard mills announce increase
summary: Several mills have announced a price increase on containerboard grades effective next quarter.

title: Polyethylene resin offers firm
summary: Resin producers hold offers firm after summer outages; film converters are passing on increases.

title: Cotton crop reduced in India
summary: Monsoon rains reduced cotton yields in key Indian growing regions. Expected impact: +3% cost.

title: Strong demand for textiles
summary: Buyer demand for cotton increasing ahead of Q4. Market tightness expected.

title: Steel imports face new tariffs
summary: New tariffs on stainless steel imports effective next month. Domestic sourcing may be more competitive.

title: Geopolitical tensions in key region
summary: Tensions in key steel producing region may disrupt supply chains. Risk premium evident in prices.

title: Adverse weather impacts tanneries
summary: Flooding in major tanning region in Bangladesh affecting production. Expected +5% cost increase.

title: Strong demand signal
summary: Buyer demand for polyester increasing ahead of Q4. Market tightness expected.

title: Supply disruption in Vietnam
summary: Supply from Vietnam disrupted due to transport issues. Expected impact: +2% cost.

title: Renewable capacity limited
summary: Cold weather expected to reduce renewable energy capacity. Winter demand may push prices up.

title: Pulp prices increasing
summary: Rising pulp prices driving corrugated cardboard costs up. Effect visible this quarter.

title: Polyethylene prices firm
summary: Oil market tightness supporting polyethylene film prices. No relief expected.

title: India reinstates cotton import duty
summary: India reinstated an import duty on cotton lint just as its own crop falls short; trade flows are being redirected and mills face higher landed cost.

title: Cotton harvest running late
summary: Late rains have delayed the harvest in key growing regions by about two weeks; early picking quality is mixed.
